build_tts_transformer_model: build a TTS transformer model using TTSTransformerModel.build_model with args and task
create_tts_transformer_encoder: create a TTSTransformerEncoder instance with args, source dictionary, and speaker embedding
create_tts_transformer_decoder: create a TTSTransformerDecoder instance with args and source dictionary for speech synthesis
run_tts_transformer_forward: run the TTSTransformerDecoder forward pass with prev_output_tokens and encoder output
load_tts_transformer_pretrained: load a pretrained TTS transformer model using TTSTransformerModel.from_pretrained with model name
